reason.synthetic_only_finding: The first executable atom-conjunction enumerator can obtain a block-complete closure primarily through incompatible outcome atoms with empty joint support. In the synthetic audit this yielded one trivial candidate containing every query, rather than a useful compositional closure.
reason.scientific_interpretation: A remaining-query state is a set of complete multi-outcome queries. Closure must therefore express when the complete responses of generator queries determine the complete response of another query, not when one conjunction of individual outcome atoms is inconsistent.
